enterprise.name: Dairy Enterprise
enterprise.description: A dairy enterprise: enteric fermentation and manure emissions from the herd, plus the farm's energy, waste and upstream (Scope 3) emissions.

customSheets.name: Results
customSheets.description: The single enterprise-wide results tab, unique to this enterprise. Module Results tabs are NOT imported; this sheet reads each module's result cells directly by named range.

customSheets.name: Input - Site
customSheets.description: Site-specific inputs for this enterprise. Has fewer fields than the typical module excel site sheet.

customSheets.name: Input - Enterprise
customSheets.description: Optional enterprise-level input sheet for values shared across modules. Imported module input sheets are kept as-is alongside this one.

customSheets.name: Input - Fert Prod System
customSheets.description: Non-user editable inputs that take values from the imported 'Input - Pasture' sheet

modules.comment: Enteric and Manure both ship an 'Input - Dairy' sheet but the manure management sheet has the full set of inputs.
Dairy has its own fertiliser production systems inputs.

Dairy only needs the pasture residue chain. The workbook now ships crop- and pasture-specific leaching/runoff sheets, so this imports Input - Pasture plus 6.2 Pasture residue N2O and 6.3 Leach runoff pasture (which depends only on the pasture residue sheet and Input - Pasture, not on any crop sheet or Input - Crop). The crop input, 6.1 Crop residue N2O and 6.4 Residue burning are not required. A bare string (like the entries above) imports every sheet the registry lists for that module; this object form subsets them.
Scope 3 contains livestock purchase inputs that are not required here as there is already a livestock purchases module in Dairy herd movement

menu.comment: The column-A navigation menu is regenerated on every sheet from the final sheet set. Groups are assigned automatically: Home/Results = untitled; any sheet named 'Input*' = INPUTS; calculation sheets = CALCULATIONS; everything else = APPENDICES. 'labels' overrides the link text for a sheet (default derivation strips the 'Input - ' prefix, otherwise uses the sheet name). Set enabled=false to leave existing menus untouched.
